name: Zargh
summary: At the Crossroads in the Barrens, Zargh sells meat and sends choice cuts to Orgrimmar.

sections.title: Butcher of the Crossroads
sections.body: At the Crossroads, Zargh sells cured meat, shank, and game from the surrounding plains. Travelers heading into the wilderness can find provisions at his shop. He also sends choice cuts across Durotar to Innkeeper Gryshka in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.

sections.title: A Courier's Errand
sections.body: Zargh sends fresh meat to Innkeeper Gryshka in Orgrimmar by wind rider, so it reaches her before it spoils. A letter from Gryshka recalls that Zargh lost a finger in a mishap. After receiving word from her, Zargh hints that a wedding invitation may be in the traveler's future.

faq.answer: You can find Zargh at the Crossroads, the central Horde settlement in the Barrens. He sells meat among the camp's merchants.

faq.q: What is Zargh's connection to Innkeeper Gryshka?
faq.answer: Zargh supplies Innkeeper Gryshka in Orgrimmar with choice meats from the Barrens. Their letters suggest a warm, personal bond, and after one arrives, Zargh hints that a wedding invitation may be coming.
A letter from Gryshka says Zargh lost a finger in a butchering accident. The mishap remains an inside joke between them about the contents of his meat cuts.
Zargh sells provisions including haunches of meat, cured ham steaks, wild hog shanks, and a recipe for Hot Lion Chops.

angles.text: As a cook, you can buy Zargh's recipe for Hot Lion Chops, one of the few such recipes sold in the Barrens. It lets you prepare local predator meat.
As a member of the Horde, you can see how the route between the Crossroads and Orgrimmar uses wind riders to carry messengers between the Barrens and Durotar.
